instruction: Use VLC to open and play the video available at: https://devstreaming-cdn.apple.com/videos/streaming/examples/img_bipbop_adv_example_fmp4/master.m3u8

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task variation instructs user to launch VLC and play a different online video using a direct HLS streaming URL. Uses existing is_vlc_playing metric and get_vlc_playing_info getter. The evaluator checks VLC's playing state via HTTP interface and verifies the streaming URL. Same complexity as original - basic video streaming with state verification. Fixed to use direct streaming URL instead of YouTube URL to avoid URL transformation issues.

llm_judge_reasons: The previous YouTube URL issue has been successfully fixed by using a direct HLS streaming URL (https://devstreaming-cdn.apple.com/videos/streaming/examples/img_bipbop_adv_example_fmp4/master.m3u8)
Direct HLS URLs are not transformed by VLC, unlike YouTube URLs which get extracted to googlevideo.com streams

The metric is_vlc_playing has robust URL matching logic (vlc.py:96-131) that handles multiple HLS representations: full URL match (line 102), filename-only match for HLS streams (lines 107-114), and domain+path matching (lines 117-122)
Complete coverage: Evaluator correctly checks both VLC state (playing) and URL verification, matching all instruction requirements
The getter get_vlc_playing_info correctly fetches VLC's status.xml via HTTP interface, and the XML parsing logic can extract URL information from multiple possible XML paths
